objective: Defeat Private Hendel in Dustwallow Marsh.

description: What?! You come here accusing me of allying with the Defias, and think I'll just stand here while you insult me?! Something tells me you've had this coming for a long time.
progress: Hello again, <name>. I hope you don't mind the assistance, but we couldn't have Hendel escaping, or worse, wind up dead.
completion: I assure you, we're all quite upset about current events, but allow us to take him back to Theramore for some questioning, and we'll see about finding the King.
I'm sure my lady Proudmore would like to thank you for your help. Speak to her when you have a moment.
